data.name: Armored Rail
data.detailed_description:
COMMAND YOUR WAR TRAIN


Take control of a massive armored locomotive with up to 75 carriages, each a platform for destruction. Your train snakes across the battlefield on procedural tracks while you orchestrate a symphony of firepower.

BUILD YOUR ARSENAL


Every carriage is a tactical choice:

  • Gatling Turrets - Hitscan weapons that shred enemies at range
  • Rocket Launchers - Explosive area damage for crowd control
  • Chain Lightning - Arcing electrical devastation that jumps between targets

Mix and match weapons across your convoy. Alternate turrets and rockets. Stack chain lightning for cascading destruction. Your train, your strategy.

ROGUELITE RUNS


Each run is different. Upgrade your weapons, unlock new carriages, and push deeper into enemy territory. When you fall, rise again stronger.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X (Vulkan 1.2 support)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU (Metal)
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13.0 (Ventura) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 Apple Silicon or newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
